bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
pg="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -Ei 'postgres' || true)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$pg" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 61
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_DB_PANEL_BEGIN\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "
SELECT panel_id,chat_id,message_thread_id,panel_type,state,COALESCE(message_id,0),pinned,(verified_at IS NOT NULL)
FROM board_menu_panels
WHERE (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=48)
OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613)
OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210)
ORDER BY chat_id,panel_type;"'
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_DB_PANEL_END\n'
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_EXISTING_PINS_BEGIN\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "
SELECT chat_id,message_thread_id,state,COALESCE(message_id,0),pinned
FROM topic_dm_entry_pins
WHERE (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=48)
OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613)
OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210); "'
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_EXISTING_PINS_END\n'
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_DB_ROUTES_BEGIN\n'
docker exec "$pg" sh -c 'psql -X -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d gaybbs -At -F "|" -c "
SELECT board_key,purpose,chat_id,message_thread_id,enabled,(verified_at IS NOT NULL)
FROM posting_topics
WHERE (chat_id=-1003847210571 AND message_thread_id=48)
OR (chat_id=-1002373696859 AND message_thread_id=1613)
OR (chat_id=-1003770334893 AND message_thread_id=210); "'
printf 'PROFILE_TOPIC_DB_ROUTES_END\n'
